contributorNote: Compiled from 'A First Course in Luyia Grammar' (G. Donohew, Kima) and 'A First Luyia Grammar' (L. L. Appleby, 1961, East African Literature Bureau) with standard Luyia cross-dialect orthography. Enriched with authentic Oluluyia / Olushiwanga vocabulary and grammatical entries systematically extracted from the 'Wanga-English Dictionary' by Alfred Anangwe & Michael R. Marlo (2008).
